# Build-time dependency manifest: slow or flaky upstream downloads.
#
# scripts/vendor.sh downloads these into vendor/blobs/ using this file as the
# only source of versions and checksums. The Dockerfile installs from the local
# copies when present and falls back to the network otherwise, so builds work
# offline once the blobs exist.
#
# Format: <sha256>  <file name>  <url>  <arch>
#   arch is one of: amd64 | arm64 | any
#   "any" marks a payload with no architecture-specific binary: pure scripts or
#   wrappers (the npm launcher packages, the s6-overlay noarch archive). It is
#   architecture-independent, NOT a payload containing builds for every arch;
#   the real binaries live in the matching amd64/arm64 records.
#   Everything not marked "any" is downloaded only for the architecture in use.
# Checksums come from the upstream release/repository metadata, not from the
# downloaded file, so a corrupted or substituted download is rejected.

# --- npm payloads: launcher wrappers (arch-independent) plus per-platform binaries ---

f1c3d923ff3ac7e7080b8b9c638833dde72feab15e46940a65a0122d728c6bfd  claude-code-linux-x64-2.1.312.tgz  https://registry.npmjs.org/@anthropic-ai/claude-code-linux-x64/-/claude-code-linux-x64-2.1.312.tgz  amd64
